72ff97eb66fa5af473c807ef53143f57ea16682f.text: Wanda wants to throw a party for fun and asks Gina for help. First, Wanda says she needs to make a list, then asks Gina to see if she can borrow her father’s car so they can go grocery shopping together. Gina is unsure her father will agree but promises to ask. They agree to try for Friday.

46cce15249db4ac57fd6e16b91811c5c49cb2c8d.text: Wanda plans a party and needs to make a list first. Gina will ask her father about using his car for Friday grocery shopping with Wanda.

016b0b05fff3b187fc43dce1c731d512a7b0abc0.text: Wanda wants to throw a party and is making a list and planning groceries. She asks Gina to borrow her father’s car and go shopping on Friday, and Gina says she’ll ask him but can’t promise.

d61a884da18355ad0d860b3edb58a5ffa0f17c7d.text: Nick compliments Jane and asks to meet for a drink. Jane dismisses him, insulting him and implying he’s out of her league. Nick gets defensive, says she’s not that attractive, and tries to withdraw the invitation. The exchange quickly devolves into mutual insults, ending with Jane calling him a loser and Nick responding with profanity.

a4fb50f1dba88af0cb9fd2e4f627f4875d597f10.text: Nick asked Jane to meet for a drink, but Jane declined and the exchange ended with both telling each other to forget it.

53ea34bcc1ff5b205637f6012fc9d133db0782e0.text: Nick asked Jane out for a drink, but she rejected him and insulted him. They ended up trading insults and angrily ended the conversation.

7a0aa303a5d61e1f71a98390665b2e88c064e5fa.text: Hannah asks Amanda for Betty’s number. Amanda checks but can’t find it, then suggests Hannah ask Larry since he called Betty last time they were at the park together. Hannah says she doesn’t know Larry well and would rather Amanda text him, but Amanda encourages her to do it herself. Hannah reluctantly agrees and ends the chat.

8a04d5a80b39b445fc799b660f00b2ed16cc2711.text: Lenny asked Bob for help choosing between several pants shown in photos. Bob said he liked the first option best, and when Lenny worried about already owning purple trousers, Bob replied that having multiple pairs of the same color was fine if they offered more outfit options. He advised Lenny to choose either the first or third pair and prioritize the best quality. Lenny agreed and thanked him.

c40ab429a812503efb628b814fe2437a6ff43c17.text: Rita and Tina commiserate about being exhausted and bored at work. They both say they’re struggling to stay awake, keep nodding off at their desks, and feel like time is dragging painfully slowly. Both express that they hate their jobs and feel they’re not suited for such monotonous work.

83b486146a0c04a44dd6b6fd6eda1be4297842a4.text: Will checks in with Emma about dinner, but she says not to worry about cooking because she’s not really okay and isn’t hungry. He asks if everything is okay and offers to pick her up, but she declines and says she’ll be home soon and will let him know when she arrives. They end the conversation by saying “I love you” to each other.

9bbfbb3eaa9c0ef7006f5465fa33de956b69b762.text: Max asks Payton for good places to buy clothes online, and Payton shares several sites, explaining that they each have different styles. Max says he’ll check them out, then asks if Payton likes shopping. Payton says yes and no—she enjoys browsing, trying things on, and seeing how they look, but not always buying because it would be too expensive. When Max asks what she usually buys, Payton says she struggles most with clothes and books, since she loves reading and reads anything she can get her hands on.

e0574a5926242170001bc487490d789f8d3ee1db.text: Eric and Rob excitedly joke about a “machine” and a funny bit involving how Americans see Russians. They laugh about a train part and the absurd way someone talks to the machine, then Eric asks whether it’s the comedian’s only stand-up. Rob checks and finds more stand-up clips on YouTube, which both of them plan to watch right away. They end the chat by repeating “MACHINE!” and saying goodbye with “TTYL?” and “Sure :)”.

42cd5b964924af18e7a11a18900704c8d7a3a4a2.text: The group discussed who would get the apartment keys. Hilary had them and said people could meet her at lunch or later. Elliot said evening drinks would work since they’d likely return together, and Daniel said he’d be with Hilary all day so any option was fine. Benjamin considered picking them up at lunchtime so he could nap, but Hilary mentioned she’d be at lunch with some French researchers at 2 p.m. at La Cantina. Benjamin joked that this might be too tempting to pass up, and Hilary encouraged him to join them, then take the keys and go nap afterward. Elliot agreed, and they planned to meet at 2 p.m.

729f196622db7440779c61bdbe56f63bbaa1bf79.text:
Ollie and Jane chatted about meeting up and coordinating plans. Jane asked about dinner dates, but Ollie was unavailable on the 18th and 19th because of a party they both needed to attend. They agreed to have lunch on Friday instead. The conversation then turned humorous when Jane mentioned hearing only “we don’t have any more whisky” from a phone call, and Ollie joked that a spy might be on his mobile.

Later, they discussed meeting again, but Jane said she was too busy for lunch the next day and suggested tea at 6 p.m. after her courses. Ollie agreed, asked if she brought pastries, and Jane replied that she had already eaten them all and was on her way.

fd65227434539a21719f8b74c460aa73322892b2.text: Ivan asks Eric if he’s coming to the wedding, clarifying it’s Ivan’s brother’s wedding. Eric says he’s unsure because he has a lot to do at home and doesn’t know if his parents will allow it. Ivan insists and jokes that he’ll handle Eric’s parents, saying Eric should just show up. Eric agrees in the end.

d2a1e54b92a65d532764dc745ada8bf6c8ffcd75.text: Charlee says they’re in class taking a Portuguese theatre course at university and preparing a performance. Curtis asks if they’re devising it and who wrote it. Charlee explains it’s a Polish play translated into Portuguese, written by Mrożek.

0927c97dd4d82d4b470c05a811df94de15330eee.text: Martin says he won two cinema tickets in an online Facebook contest run by a movie magazine, where he only had to write a short review. The prize is for the new film with Redford, which he heard is good and is available until the end of the week. Aggie congratulates him and says they’ll find time to go see it.

7d5d5c8266cc420c0c3dd9519000b809896a8bcd.text: Mary asked whether they were going by car or train. Tom replied that Ella had rented a car, and Ella said this would make everything much faster. Mary then agreed it was a good decision.

3955af7b0298e53c28e985b94ea455623166e117.text: Beatrice is shopping and offers to buy Leo a scarf from a nearby shop. Leo refuses, saying he doesn’t need or like scarves. Beatrice insists anyway, reminding him that he was sick a lot last winter and saying he’ll get one regardless. Leo responds sarcastically, and Beatrice dismisses his complaints, saying she’s had enough of his whining.

3fe82a6a6a12909eddbd1811aa658eddf8f410fc.text: Greg tells Betsy he has to stay after work, but Betsy is frustrated because he says this again. Greg asks Betsy to pick up Johnny from kindergarten, but she says she can’t because she also has to work late and reminds him that Tuesdays are his responsibility. Greg says he’ll figure something out, while Betsy tells him to come up with a solution. The conversation ends tensely, with Greg telling her to stop.

b43c55f8676e5059a1947fcc4c6a47ee6c5ed3ef.text: The conversation is playful banter among friends. Ethan shares something “for Scott,” and Toby and Marshall joke that it “sums it up.” Scott fires back that they’re just as bad, while Toby and Marshall tease him more, saying they enjoy making fun of him. Ethan laughs, Scott tells them off, and Toby ends with a GIF.

82362aad364b0f24d048d551392bff98059d4422.text: Luke asked Paul if he was still looking for someone to join his Netflix family account, and Paul said yes, he needed one more person. Luke volunteered, and Paul agreed to send the login and password on Sunday. Luke suggested talking the next day and also asked for Paul’s bank details so he could pay monthly, asking whether Paul was covering the account himself or if someone else was. Paul replied that he pays for it himself and keeps track of who accesses it, so there shouldn’t be any bans. The conversation then shifted to Paul’s holiday with his girlfriend: Luke asked if he was still on vacation and how long he’d been there, and Paul said it was their last dinner, they’d leave the next day, and they’d been there for less than 8 days.

20604aeb0ab33c8da8f811284417d2da13a86315.text: Ernest asks Mike if he parked his car on their street. Mike says no, he took it to the garage today. Ernest explains that someone just crashed into a red Honda that looked like Mike’s. Mike jokes that he was lucky to have taken it to the garage.

57a35b7b2875af8f47e8c31d33962f4b7fa77f7e.text: Igor complains about being overloaded and unmotivated at work during his notice period. John agrees it’s unfair but encourages Igor to keep going, saying how you finish something reflects who you are. Igor jokes back, and John advises him to push through the last two weeks and focus on getting the work done, though Igor says that’s easier said than done.

8b93910e9b6d80bcf3cbb694eb1def1d0c82508f.text: Clara tells Neela about rewatching *Dear White People* on Netflix and recommends it enthusiastically. She explains that the show is set at a fictional Ivy League university and follows Black students, with themes of race, discrimination, and campus politics. Clara mentions key plot points like a Blackface party, a confrontation involving a campus policeman and Reggie, and Lionel’s storyline about being gay and becoming a journalist. Neela says it sounds interesting and plans to watch it.

a0f5b1c4d41c418cc5684ae6455c00c462ea5499.text: Beth messages her aunt Deirdre to ask about doing work experience at the salon. Deirdre suggests they meet to discuss it and warns that Beth should also consider college or sixth form, since Beth is struggling with exams but is interested in beauty therapy. They agree Beth can come in the next day to meet the salon manager, Maxine, and try a few Saturday sessions as work experience, with a small payment for expenses if it goes well. In the same conversation, they also talk about planning Beth’s mum’s 40th birthday, possibly as a girls’ weekend surprise.

9ba5fbe8cca7373bc36f9f598a69472e6fc9f956.text: Gloria explains that the exam is somewhat unpredictable and relies heavily on experience, though there are still recurring text types and phrases. She shares a useful website with past exam texts, which Emma finds very helpful. They discuss the exam timing: 4 hours for all four parts, with no breaks. Gloria says that’s just enough, though extra time would be nice, and emphasizes the need to stay focused, write quickly, and reserve the last hour for careful proofreading. Emma decides to study the website’s materials.

2c91f8a767d0336cee8de7e772e4ce549d24d596.text: Adam and Karen discuss their concern for May, who seems to be showing signs of depression. Adam says May seems unable to enjoy anything, lacks motivation, sleeps poorly, and avoids going out. Karen says she already suggested that May see a specialist, but May reacted badly and doesn’t want to see anyone. Both worry the situation is serious and agree they may not be able to help on their own without making things worse. Karen suggests calling a trusted psychologist friend for advice, without mentioning May’s name, and Adam agrees.

40161112254d63a7c9700390e52a09b17e239a2e.text: Anne discovered that Mark lied about his age. He had told her he was 30, but after seeing his passport, she found out he is actually 40. Irene questioned whether it was a big issue, but Anne was upset because he had lied to her.

83f89f63be0fecce34c32d636c77f4d7c4ac6760.text: The group chats about Wharton’s birthday next week and starts planning a party and gift. Walker says Wharton once mentioned wanting a paper shredder, which surprises Augustine. Heather and Darlene joke about whether they should really buy office equipment, but Darlene says to confirm with Wharton first. Walker agrees to ask him again, and Augustine suggests doing it tomorrow while Darlene adds that he should also ask about the party.

4a24dc37e3fe9c67b85b9aeea23d2bbdbdcaefbc.text: Myah sent a photo, but Selah couldn’t read the phone number clearly and asked for it to be rewritten. Myah sent another photo, after which Selah said the person’s phone was off.

f6a2484bdb318a450ead7ea896db3a3dfa2044ee.text: Eric asked Bella whether the boss was angry about what happened in his room. Bella said he was not angry at all; instead, he appreciated their bold decision to reject a client’s request. Eric was surprised, since the clients were potential business, and Bella explained that the boss was aiming to attract new clients who competed with their current one. Eric congratulated Bella, and she described the situation as a “blessing in disguise.”

389bbfa540e8d155dc547625e05d1bc8f768622c.text: Emma is on the bus near the back because there are free seats, and she wants to nap. Ben tells her they should arrive in New York around 4:30 PM if traffic isn’t too bad. Emma asks Ben to wake her around 4:15 PM, and he agrees.

ccc00bd12c9c52263e9ac9748eee2d765609ced6.text: Mary asks Carter to lend her some money because she’s broke. Carter agrees but says he needs an hour because he’s at the train station. Mary thanks him.

5f4c1c4d936f4c5343056d760673726321f30203.text: Charlotte asks Paula how to pronounce “Natal lily,” wondering if it refers to the South African region rather than the word “natal.” Paula replies that it’s pronounced “nu tell,” with stress on the second syllable. Charlotte confirms and thanks her warmly, and Paula responds with affectionate emoticons and shared audio files.

55c3af9e09d3097ae8bc1b360bcc8c5ba8a98945.text: Margaret asks Jack to buy her some painkiller because she has a terrible headache. Jack asks what’s wrong and suggests she rest instead.

13ea39a54632ca09b7ac25780abe0c298146a017.text: Jack asks May if she wants cocktails later. May enthusiastically agrees and says he read her mind. Jack notices she seems tense, and May admits she is, saying a drink will help. Jack suggests maybe two drinks.

8f8a02f46ccb05f54bca3f2151a49b04fb947ef8.text: Jesse suggests doing something charitable for the holidays, specifically helping women and children through The Refuge, a foundation that shares wish lists from survivors of abuse. The group agrees to contribute, reviews three possible wish lists, and initially leans toward the second one as the easiest. Jesse prefers the third list, and after some discussion about pooling money and planning logistics, the others agree. They settle on choosing the third wish list.

1827f705ff3408dc423d0d39e0606f237a89f565.text: The conversation is a playful exchange where friends take turns describing creepy places. Kelly shares a sculpture garden in Finland that feels disturbing because of the huge number of human-like sculptures with eerie faces staring at visitors. Ollie then describes Nagoro village in Japan, where there are more life-sized human figures than actual residents, making the place feel unsettling. The others react with surprise and disgust, and everyone agrees both places are creepy before ending the chat and saying goodbye.

6290d8c9b64d184d3e760c999a3e1e384f28396a.text: Janice said her son wants a hamster for his birthday and asked if she should get one. Martina strongly advised against it, saying she got one for her own son and it made the whole house smell bad.

0c160c2817b5545ddfd8af9a430fe7cf89547713.text: Andrei asks Serge whether he picked up the film equipment for tonight’s shoot. Serge says he is on his way there now and has his credit card, though it has limited available credit. Andrei asks him to use it to pay an overdue company bill, and Serge says he’ll see if it works when he arrives and will let Andrei know.

a308ec9e01ef82487883179506825dcb351b34ee.text: Judy says she keeps being drawn to jerks. Janice asks about Andrew, and Judy explains that he only wanted sex and then stopped contacting her once he got it. Janice then asks about Bruce, who Judy says is kind and caring, but she doesn’t feel the excitement or “butterflies” with him because he may be too sweet.

ccbb89480776e3a8e2414d2d1a21107b96688b4b.text: Daniel asks if anyone has played Dragon Age. Mary clarifies he means **Dragon Age: Inquisition**, says she loves it, and is a big **Dorian** fan. Lucas asks if it’s any good, mentioning he only played **Dragon Age II**. Mary enthusiastically says it’s “fucking brilliant” and tells Daniel to keep playing, especially because of Dorian. Daniel says he’s just started and is still adjusting to the mechanics. When Lucas asks whether it’s better than DA2, Mary answers **yes**.

f73017ceec5637a41c7e5f9ae15e028cad9af65f.text: Riley excitedly tells James that Chloe is on TV. James asks which channel, then finds it himself and asks what Chloe is doing. Riley explains it’s a makeover-type program where women undergo a complete metamorphosis, and says Chloe now looks stunning.

178b1a6a56b77b25abb24a4aa971d8123e032c00.text: Tina complimented the appearance of Emirates staff, and Ala explained that the airline intentionally puts a lot of effort into its image. Tina then mentioned a frustrating airport delay that kept passengers on the plane for an hour, though she jokingly noted it gave them a very talkative pilot. Ala sympathized, said she was heading to an important meeting, and Tina wished her luck and asked to hear how it went.

b05d45beb021789623a9baa75796ce9e95263b12.text: Frank asks his son to come home this weekend because his mother misses him. The son says he isn’t sure at first, but after hearing that his mother misses him, he agrees to try and then confirms he will come.

9806cf94ec34cf532e25cdfad36ac523506c1450.text:
Sebastian says the past year since moving has been the best time of his life. He feels he has learned a lot, become more resourceful and responsible, and gained the confidence that he can achieve his dreams. He also says that his love life is going well.

Kevin responds supportively, saying he’s glad Sebastian is happy and satisfied with his choices, though he jokes that he wishes he had someone special too and that Sebastian’s optimism about finding love is a bit unrealistic. Sebastian encourages him anyway, saying that if you want something badly enough, you can achieve it, even joking about applying that idea to winning the lottery. Kevin congratulates Sebastian and says he’s genuinely happy for him.

9e815aca4734bd0e0275ab814e26c81dc2882fdb.text: Mike asked Ann for John’s new number. Ann didn’t have it and suggested asking Mary instead. Mike agreed and thanked her.

533063330171dab52890a6979d12fb841eb1fc9c.text: Josh realized Stephen might have accidentally taken his notebook home, but Stephen checked and didn’t have it. Jack then admitted he had the notebook by mistake and said he’d bring it back tomorrow.

a349f60c782bc2fa1c92b2af452ec02fd043b5fa.text: Joseph shared a fuzzy photo and asked Ella to identify it. Ella guessed “baby cows,” and Joseph clarified that his uncle Janek has twin cows. After teasing him for saying “tween” instead of “twins,” Ella reacted enthusiastically and said it was cool, then joked that she wanted to touch the cows.

da5ff5da18461f4541108541a3fa54692e6c7664.text: Ola apologizes for being out of touch while traveling in Cuba, explaining the poor connectivity, and says they’re fine and enjoying the trip. Kate says she’d been worried, mentions Christmas happenings, and shares that Momo has recovered and even stolen Ola’s scarf. Ola is upset because it was one of their favorites from Laos. Kate jokes that Momo can keep it and suggests buying a new one in Cuba. Ola complains that the local clothes are mostly cheap, ugly embroidered tops and no shawls or scarves. Kate sends a photo of a blouse that might suit Ola’s mom and encourages them to look in better shops rather than markets. Ola agrees to try, offers to look for one for Kate too, and Kate says no thanks, joking that their mom would want to be the only one with an authentic Cuban blouse. They end with greetings and goodbyes.

dbf3c780de31eb97eb13ea5957b345f45a2317f6.text: Adele tells Lola she got a new 4-month-old Labrador puppy named Bones, nicknamed for how plump he is. Lola asks how the other pets reacted, and Adele says the cats keep their distance while Poppy and Lulu act motherly and Speedy wants to play. They joke about how puppies are usually more readily accepted than adult dogs, and Adele mentions her past experience taking in adult dogs, especially female ones that tended to fight. Lola ends by saying she can’t wait to see the puppy.

c1f6e864a3c249901d017fc79b1a9f23be9ab62e.text: Cathy realizes she left her sunglasses at Broke’s place, and Broke confirms they’re there. Cathy says she may stop by around 10 p.m. to pick them up, and Broke agrees.

8970bba00472ef639b1574fce3dc8ba921fef7e5.text: Kristian and Tabora play a quick “this or that” game. Kristian asks a series of preference questions—Adidas or Nike, watermelon or orange, Superman or Batman, and films or books—and Tabora answers each one (Adidas, orange, Batman, and films). Tabora asks what they’re doing and when it’s her turn, and Kristian explains they’re just playing games and asks if she wants to continue. Tabora agrees and says it’s fun.

f823456cfb68b3a58fe91bd0170770368b96946f.text: Lilly said she would be late and told Gabriel to go ahead and order food without waiting for her. Gabriel kindly offered to order something for her so it would be ready when she arrived, and Lilly agreed, suggesting pasta with salmon and basil as a tasty choice.

f504c3a4ea0822f0eed647080592c317447b18f1.text: Adam says a friend saw Tim with another guy and shares a photo, which leads Nate to react with surprise. Julia reveals she already knew Tim is gay and assumed everyone else did too. Adam and Nate are upset that Tim didn’t tell them, saying Adam embarrassed himself defending Tim and that, as his friends, they should have been told. Julia pushes back, saying it wasn’t her place to share his private life and asks what difference it actually makes.

8818fdeb51650e48ea8dcd1ccde92602cf116c63.text: The conversation is a humorous exchange about everyone being tired and bored at work. Petra says she is extremely sleepy and can barely stay awake, while Andy agrees that the office is dull because nobody is working. Ezgi interrupts to say she is working, calling them “lazy pigs.” Petra jokes that she’s “sleeping with her eyes open” and wants to be killed. Andy suggests asking the “fat woman from HR,” and they joke that she would kill Petra instantly and claims to have a black belt in karate. Petra responds with more sarcasm, saying it’s hard to believe she can move but she can keep whatever belt she wants. The conversation ends with Petra still complaining about being very sleepy.

015dd8f0f54a7b18b31ff57a1ac200d777f19bef.text: Craig asked Derek for help with his computer because it wasn’t working, though he wasn’t sure what was wrong. Derek said he could help but needed about 20 minutes to get to his car first, and Craig agreed and thanked him.

1fca248181cf874bd66972edc2ef12b78d4a6405.text: Cara asked Celine if she was at home because she wanted to stop by. Celine said she wasn’t home and apologized, offering to come by in the evening instead. Cara said that was fine and asked Celine to call if she decided to come, and Celine agreed.

eff29f636c18079744bb13cee709683c9de545b7.text: Emma invited Abigail to go for a walk with the children, but Abigail declined because her smog alert app showed pollution levels were 30% above normal. Emma was concerned and said she should install the app too.

5345e8d0ac292e3427701597eaa346d15b9a4f1e.text: Paul asked Cindy what color flowers he should get. Cindy said any color except yellow. Paul suggested pink, but Cindy changed her mind and said maybe red. When Paul asked for a clear color and type, Cindy finally replied: red roses.

0012e13051a0075dad93e93469d880ce2d947153.text: Mary let Jenny know that her credit card had been left at the shop and was safely being held by a cashier. Jenny thanked Mary and asked when she could pick it up. Mary replied that Jenny could come any time to collect it.

8905a8dc91e7abb716330f5e6ab265578dfab278.text: Salma shared the latest cat meme, Hugh replied enthusiastically that he loves cat memes, sent a photo back, and Salma laughed and agreed.

1b4d8ad02ead934b37ac8ed3e8639866618ac34c.text: Laura asks Paul where he is, and Paul keeps saying he’s almost there and about 15 minutes away. Laura becomes frustrated because she’s already waited 30 minutes and decides she won’t wait any longer, telling him they can meet another time. Paul apologizes and asks her to wait, but Laura refuses, saying she is not sorry.

c797e3a5190ab78fc3c76845f27f5285aa399f3d.text: Jake says they don’t have English class today because Smith called in sick and they couldn’t find a replacement. Nadia reacts with surprise, and Vanessa asks for confirmation before Jake explains the reason.

84f30d5311498ed0c2f09f5379cd845668868ea6.text: Gary reminds Lara about Tom’s birthday party. Lara asks what time to arrive, and Gary says around 5 PM so they can prepare before Tom gets home at 5:30. Lara compliments Gary for being a great boyfriend and offers to pick up the cake and balloons, but Gary says he has already paid for the cake. They agree to meet at 5 PM to get everything ready.

ef780e5f24625daad8ec8475f11bd03cd8697f23.text: Brandon lost his credit card and blocked it at the bank, but he’ll have to wait for a replacement. He asked his friends for $100. Luke said he was broke and couldn’t help, while Ian offered to lend Brandon the money, and Brandon thanked him.

4728df2c5da2e0b6b12ed54d2e3a1c7e530c9600.text: The conversation is about Stanford admissions results. Oliver says the results have been posted, and Peter learns he didn’t get in. Matt checks and confirms he was admitted, and Oliver says he got in too, but only barely. Peter congratulates them despite his disappointment. Matt and Oliver encourage Peter not to give up and say there are other options. Peter thanks them, warns them to send their documents quickly or risk getting stuck in a queue, and says he needs to look for another university before saying goodbye.

3a18f0f85318c076dc335ed34066506b8e445dd5.text: Ana asked Catherine if she was awake and suggested they visit their grandma the next day because she misses her. Catherine agreed it would be nice and said she’d call Ana when she woke up. They then wished each other good night.

c1bb1b760fc4a1d3427ef1092748ad77074c42ac.text: Joyce shared a link, Michael thought it was cheap, and Edson was so excited he said he was booking his ticket right away.

622a772f96491798e85c22c6773a015e9554bae0.text: Jane and Steven discuss travel time and where to meet. Jane says Google Maps estimates the trip will take at least 3 hours and notes the distance is nearly 300 km, while Steven is confident they can make it in less time because the road is new. To avoid stress, Jane asks to meet at 4:30 instead of 5, and Steven agrees. They also decide to meet at the main entrance.

2a50387dc54f325392a08087b9ece4be72a0765b.text: Morgan and Suzanne flirted while chatting about Suzanne’s boring workday. Morgan said he missed her and invited her to a Maroon 5 concert at Hulu Theater at Madison Square Garden, mentioning he had two tickets. Suzanne was excited and grateful, and Morgan said he just wanted to make her happy.

21d7a2de8dd34958aef9cb5a7d63009b40d524f8.text: The conversation is a cheerful group chat about planning more “Food Evenings” after a successful dinner together. Inez starts the chat and suggests a new restaurant, apparently Korean, with a photo. Everyone reacts positively: Alicja jokes about being happier going to work because of the meal, Gosia says she’s an “expert at eating,” and Patrycja says she enjoyed the evening, including the pizza. They all agree the first outing was great and that the new restaurant fits their theme of trying world cuisines, moving from Italy to Korea. Finally, they discuss scheduling another meet-up before the holidays and settle on going again on Wednesday in two weeks, which everyone agrees to.

2d4dbd45f08b3291969eb37c80e8e80c059ec871.text: Ali thought he might have left his wallet at Mohammad’s place and asked him to check. Mohammad looked around his room and found it. Ali was relieved and asked Mohammad to bring the wallet to university the next day, and Mohammad agreed.

7d9e2f16316af31cf9ce5679ac7362c8cf9f5eae.text: Liam asked Julia if she had read a book, and she said she didn’t even know it existed but thanked him for sharing it. She mentioned the last book she read was *Die Again*. Liam said the book was from around 2014 and told her that the city library might be organizing a meeting with Tess, which Julia thought would be awesome. Liam advised her to check the library’s Facebook page for details.

18134fde2d3136ad36d66481e81957e4ba38b520.text: Laura asked where they would go tomorrow. Linda suggested an Italian restaurant, and Laura agreed. Linda said she loves their pasta and brownie. Laura noted that she thought Linda didn’t eat sweets, and Linda replied that this brownie isn’t very sweet.

d63d86df6c833919bcc7a18c9c42029cf6676341.text: Mia asked Elliot if she could go out after work, and he said yes. She explained it was a girls’ night out with drinks and time away from work. Elliot told her not to stay out too late and offered to pick her up if she needed a ride.

5067e0a78b40094ea1f7f89404a489f7cd295604.text: The conversation is a short group chat with a playful tone. Natalie comments that something is finally happening, Martin replies with a thumbs-up, and Adam asks whether there is any confirmed information. Anna then announces her birthday party invitation for November 6th at 7:30 PM and says she would be very happy if everyone came. Martin, Margot, and Mia respond positively with heart and thumbs-up reactions.

670420e7a4ca2cdd6d26c4f85ab45758f9536761.text: John told Ela he was coming in 10 minutes and asked her to leave his wallet outside because he had forgotten it and was in a hurry. Ela replied that she had seen the wallet and told him to call her when he arrived. John complained that her phone was busy, which is why he texted her, and asked her to keep it free because he was getting late. Ela explained she had been talking to her mom but said her phone was free now. John then acknowledged and said okay.

4a5c4bf3977d257075b7c7e355887d6865dde4e4.text: Steve mentioned that the USA won last night and that England would play Croatia tomorrow at 2:00. Gulab said he had forgotten to check and then confirmed the upcoming match by asking if it was Croatia, which Steve verified.

684f57d00d1b4767a75740f0c8045cb71b9c4607.text: Fiona asks Tina if she’s free and says she wants to make Tina’s tart for a dinner with Chris. Tina agrees to help and says the recipe is easy, but asks if Fiona has anything prepared. Fiona admits she bought the crust and has had trouble making the filling before, ending up with “lemony scrambled eggs.” Tina reassures her and explains that the key is to keep mixing once the eggs are added so they don’t scramble.

4636f8bdb3d5d63e1a332a849dfd7240eb6842ef.text: Mary asked Mark why he told his sister about her online job. Mark admitted he did it because his sister kept calling Mary “good for nothing,” and he felt proud and wanted to make her jealous. Mary said she doesn’t care what the sister thinks, but she was upset that the sister was trying to contact the people she works for. Mark apologized, and Mary said she understood but warned him to be careful because his sister can be meddlesome. In the end, Mary said it felt good that the sister was jealous, though she still disliked her interference. They both reassured each other, calmed down, and ended the conversation affectionately.

c645608a4ea3a53e8b28d243f756d9095e878349.text: Jayden said they do not want kids because pregnancy and motherhood would end a “normal life” for a woman, causing physical suffering, body changes, and constant obligation. They contrasted this with men, whom they see as only having sex and then waiting for children without the same burden. Brennan disagreed, saying he would support a partner through it and joked about finding another mother for his kids. Jayden described seeing a pregnant woman struggle to pick up dropped money as an example of the suffering involved and said they hope it will someday be possible to have children without pregnancy. Brennan apologized for his comments and wished Jayden could find a man who would have sex without causing pregnancy. Jayden clarified they do not want children now, but might consider them in the future if they have a good job and financial independence.

9d42628b77fd5ccef0bdff124c9c590f770c2691.text: The group was trying to arrange drinks at Jesus bar. Peadar asked who was coming, but several people couldn’t make it: Clare was out of town, Annette was home sick with “lung lurgy,” and Anne had double-booked herself. Oli checked if people were at Jesus bar, and James and Helen confirmed they were heading there around 9:15 and invited others to join. Peadar jokingly asked Oli if he was coming too, and Oli said he had cycled to the bar but couldn’t find anyone. Clare teased him about “cycling around the bar,” and Oli clarified he meant to the bar.

a052002c5d187ed75febad2bc0f001fdc5c6fe1a.text: Ryan expressed concern and shared a file, after which Sebastian identified the situation as involving Ukraine and criticized the ongoing “Russian circus.” Ryan said he hoped world leaders would respond, and Sebastian agreed, saying he hoped so too.

540365a6992152145b38befb91d27602f2f41de0.text: Harry says he doesn’t need a gift, but if Kim’s mom wants to get him something, he’d like pillows for his new sofa, preferably grey ones.

c27cd16ab27012603b987d96a782b326676a7a41.text: Harry asks if Jacob listened to a song he sent three days earlier. Jacob admits he forgot, and Harry teases him for forgetting again. Jacob apologizes, says he’ll listen later that night, and Harry says he’s curious about Jacob’s opinion. Jacob says he’s busy and will tell him later, and they end the chat politely.

3dfb807c406bf4b8da7dd93a63726a0b0ba04d70.text: Finn invited Zadie to join him the next day in Elephant and Castle to explore the area’s Latin American businesses and food before redevelopment changes it. They joked about the vague, undefined nature of the plan and the “unspecified” Latin American cuisine. Zadie agreed to meet around 2 PM at the shopping centre’s main entrance, and Finn thanked her for going along with his ill-defined idea.

eeaef9de89e5fb323c832802a8eefe13cf3992ac.text: Ray got locked out of his room after someone locked the door from the outside, and he urgently asked Max to let him out because he needed to pee. Max wasn’t in his room and couldn’t help directly, but he got a roommate to open the door. Ray was relieved, and Max joked around while helping.

38309886c550e4609c164a871a6293eb31e0fcda.text: Frank asks Andy why he isn’t studying for a quiz tomorrow, but Andy says he’s just watching Arrow and plans to study later. Frank keeps pushing him to study now, warning that Andy probably won’t wake up in time tomorrow. Andy brushes him off by saying Frank isn’t his dad, and Frank responds with annoyance.

ed2e0713ed488a05261dcef60575fe8a94d14292.text: Josh asked Brian for advice on buying an iPad and whether Apple was a good choice. Brian discouraged Apple, saying it was overpriced for the logo, and recommended other brands like Samsung, Xiaomi, and Sony depending on budget. When Josh mentioned a budget of 2000, Brian sent a couple of options and said he could get a Samsung cheaper. Josh agreed and Brian told him to call after work.

df811043382737f48128ca8fd07794a6612fef3b.text: The group discussed plans for New Year’s Eve. Nathalie initially suggested something classy like the opera, but Olafur wasn’t interested. He preferred partying somewhere, and Zoe asked about the cost. After some back-and-forth, Zoe shared a “Breakfast at Tiffany’s” party idea, which everyone agreed looked classy enough. Nathalie was especially excited about the club and decided they would go to Soho. Olafur noted they needed to buy tickets soon, and Zoe agreed.

301f574ccd957894266bbfac5d85c92e0863e370.text: Kim asked Margot where to find fresh ramal fish in Warsaw. Margot suggested the Polna street marketplace, but Kim had already tried it and couldn’t find any local fish market online. Margot then suggested checking restaurant menus and asking where they source the fish. Kim liked the idea and said she would try, as she had nothing to lose. When Margot asked why she needed the fish, Kim revealed she planned to grill it for a surprise, but kept the details secret. Margot was curious and wished her luck finding it.

288177b81c2afaa8058d6ebf9d727c2e65977634.text: Tom tells Ben that they’ve decided on a 2pm meeting in the Oval Room and warns him to bring all his papers because it will be a tough confrontation. He uses violent battle language, saying to “take no prisoners” and “shoot to kill,” while Ben agrees and jokes that they have to win. Tom ends by saying they will win because justice is on their side.

d51e658caa4f4b6a4533a403bd2787dbe38818e3.text: Maddie asked John if he needed anything while she was at Asda. John said he wanted white bread and some apples. Maddie asked if he meant Gala apples, and John confirmed yes.

917c60098e8ba8a2e5809df2a76d06d08098902b.text: Ashleigh excitedly says they’re going to the cinema and then reveals she got the job. Peter reacts by asking if she got the job and responds with a celebratory GIF, and Ashleigh replies with another GIF.

4d4146b79138a7c9a8e4ca63dcd97e875fd9da12.text: Flo said she couldn’t get a salon appointment until the 6th because they were too busy and joked that she’d go gray. Gina suggested buying a touch-up kit at Tesco, and Flo agreed she’d have to do that.

50ae9b404d6673099e1a2cca8d8c84794c841a27.text: Danna and Reed chat about their Saturday. Reed says his day was alright and that he’s just in bed with no TV subscription, while Danna says her day is boring because several friends were unavailable, leaving her frustrated and likely stuck watching TV. They also mention that Reed has tomorrow off work, which Danna thinks is nice.

77ae03d6258932fd19ca3746bd1deda1e769f4cf.text: Elliot said he was too busy to talk and asked to call Jordan back in about two hours. Jordan replied that he couldn’t wait because he was heading to a funeral and would call Elliot later that night. Elliot agreed, asked whose funeral it was, and Jordan explained it was for his colleague Brad, who had liver cancer. Elliot expressed sympathy and said he would call Jordan at 8 p.m.

4b137e69348db90fe43d84380bb4c117b0d3aed1.text: Antonio checks in because Alivia has been quiet. She says she’s been trying to work on her thesis, but writing it is hard; she can read and research fine, yet she freezes up when she tries to write because she worries she sounds stupid. Antonio empathizes, advises her to stop overthinking and just get something down first, then edit later, and says it usually gets easier after the beginning. Alivia appreciates the support and says she’ll try.

a2795d79c0905b327b9e30c453aadf586f4010e0.text: The conversation is a crude, sexually explicit exchange in which Marvin asks Melany about her sex life and then makes a mocking, insulting joke about her genitalia.

2aeacca8538832f82dfc9bf1a8bcd13be262faeb.text: Jacky tells David he was right yesterday, specifically about taking the blame. David jokes that he’s right about most things and asks if they can talk later. Jacky agrees and says she’ll call him when she gets home.

3473681d9c5264930fc1ffbe20e4c5ddd635d52a.text: Ying shared a photo for a “10 years challenge,” and Helen, Norma, and Zazu reacted with surprise and admiration. Zazu especially said they were impressed.

68ebc20ebb0b604e23c424f3895f7c7c47280c01.text: Rob called Ann while she was in a meeting to ask if they needed anything from the grocery store. Ann said they were fine for supper and lunch tomorrow, but suggested picking up some fruit and vegetables—specifically cucumbers, tomatoes, bananas, and apples, plus anything Rob wanted. Rob agreed to get them.

428fb3938fb4d70c678ab891363c494b32dc315c.text: Chris and Rick arrange a Skype call while Rick is in Cancun before heading to Havana. Chris is in a much later time zone, so they first compare the time difference and realize the current time isn’t ideal. They settle on Skypeing the next day around 3 pm Rick’s time, since Rick says Cuba will likely have poor internet. Chris asks Rick to pass along love to Helen, and Rick agrees.

7eb7136d2a972a0450ae83e0841260fae427ffe1.text: The conversation is playful and sarcastic. Eric shares a video, saying it’s about a recent scandal on the news. Noah jokingly quotes a boastful “I knew this would happen” line, and Samantha laughs, saying she no longer needs to watch the video because the joke makes the point clear.

2530fe9de41e887d27bb9acddecf9ae920e04394.text: Daniel asks Missy what time she gets off work, and she says 6. Daniel suggests getting drinks after dinner, and Missy agrees enthusiastically.

50dc87ba832edabf8ebf651d703f925984876ad1.text: Pete asked Adelle if she had cleaned the hamster cage. Adelle said no and asked if it was her turn. Pete confirmed it was and told her to do it after school with no excuses. Adelle agreed.

0afc2b36dc5b20f03fd4c7eda8e02f4471ea869d.text: Hollie checked in by asking how Amy was. Amy replied briefly, said she was working and would get back later, and Hollie acknowledged with “Ok.”

1939ab22c3bc9832f29813a2206688c47dcd0b04.text: Isabella greeted Betty, thanked her for sharing about her work the day before, and said she’d be happy to do something together sometime. Betty replied with thanks.

a7ea3c31d2ff3c40b5d5ecb4d6df02deaefd9f61.text: Randolph asked Maya, who was still at the pharmacy, to buy him earplugs. Maya asked how many, and Randolph said 4 or 5 packs. Maya agreed to get 5, and Randolph thanked her.

ce6dfa0537d8aa0408742bcad303f7545a7e7933.text: Huda invited Alex to go swimming in two hours, and Alex agreed to join and said they’d be there. Huda then said, “See ya.”

392d8ddee5b927ab7c67721f7558793cdfa47244.text: Jane asks David if he’s coming home for Christmas next week, and he says yes. She then asks what to get his dad for Christmas, since she can’t think of anything. David suggests an iPad because his dad could use it to read books, email, watch movies, and play games. Jane agrees and asks where she can buy one, and David says he’ll order it online and have it shipped home. Jane thanks him and asks him to let her know once his travel plans are finalized.

54f01136cc093a2055c001cc09920452d36214ea.text: The conversation is a group of people angrily mocking Donald Trump for missing a ceremony. They call him cowardly, selfish, embarrassing, and immature, with repeated insults focused on his behavior and appearance, especially his hair and makeup. Several people suggest he skipped the event because of rain and didn’t want to ruin his look, while others criticize his advisers and note that other leaders managed to attend despite the weather.

ca305305cf199d6baba5c14ec2e677008ac1e067.text: Rashi told her teacher she was confused about choosing a career because there are too many options and she has multiple interests. The teacher advised her to pick a career based on genuine interest and passion, while also considering earnings and balancing duties with success. She suggested starting with something that interests her, gaining experience, and then expanding her scope over time. Rashi understood the advice and thanked the teacher for helping her.

f25b11b5dec6326cab76c6f2f0f47e646586d6dd.text: Corbin contacts the department responsible for school violence to report abuse at Jungang High School. He says his friend is the victim and asks for help, while also expressing fear of retaliation if the report is traced back to him. Dimitri reassures Corbin, asks for his phone number, and says he will call him back right away.

c3529623da578e841f8c9a3c19d581297d0919fb.text: Ann asked Fiona for help planning her dad’s 50th birthday. Fiona suggested ideas like a surprise party, a movie ticket, bungee jumping, and parachuting, but Ann said her dad wouldn’t like those. After discussing his interests, they landed on the idea of going paintballing with the whole family, since her dad likes military movies. Ann liked the suggestion, though she wasn’t sure how her mum would react.

e1b3a58c4dbd5201148721961959199ce4510792.text: Lisa says she has to clean the house because it’s very dirty and asks Bob to help since he helped make it dirty. She assigns him the bathroom, including the sink, tub, counter, and toilet, but Bob complains it’s a lot of work and refuses, saying she’ll just give him more work after he finishes.

8c9a0e0b5f50cabcf2cda293092055f3aea10496.text: Luke and Martial agree that, despite their injuries, they should make themselves available for selection the next day. They decide to inform José Mourinho early in the morning, meet up at Carrington, and go together to his office to let him know they’re ready to play because the team needs them with fixtures piling up.

f0848a90172b02912f8acf444c1de15d02f9734f.text: Marta asked Joel if he knew a good PC repair technician. Joel said he didn’t know one personally, but suggested asking Cynthia or Elena, since they might have recommendations. He mentioned that the best IT person he knows, Pablo, is currently on vacation. Marta thanked him and said she would try Cynthia and Elena.

e9025159ca7c822e3279ba0ea200df208a746868.text: Frederick asks Ricky if he likes their new next-door neighbors, saying they seemed cool when they met. Ricky says the neighbors are nice but very noisy, and mentions their parakeet kept squawking all night. Frederick responds jokingly, “sucks to be you.”

d666bbddf862aecb4f850bc630f3c53754a53361.text: Julie and Emily exchange affectionate Christmas greetings. Emily sends Julie lots of kisses and holiday wishes, and Julie replies with warm Merry Christmas wishes and hopes for a lovely mood all year. They both thank each other and share photos.

2acf9beb5783b69a06ff07455219791d7f94a35d.text: John asks Joan to see **“A Star Is Born” on Wednesday**, but she says she’s too busy. She then offers **Thursday instead**, and John agrees. They settle on **around 8 PM**, and John says he’ll check where it’s playing and send her the details.

6e56e8e56349f48d86cf208deb9022a85e7254f9.text: Louis says he has to go because his mom is calling. Fabian says okay and says goodbye, and Louis says goodbye back.

4dabec5172fde5239f16bfbc221b89cd0c00cfa7.text: Lincoln and Fatima chat casually, but the conversation turns to problems between Fatima’s friends Jenson and Alene. Fatima explains that Jenson is upset and thinks Alene may be depressed, but she refuses to get help. Lincoln responds bluntly, saying it’s not Fatima’s problem and that people need to deal with their own issues. Fatima says she cares because they’re both her friends and worries about what will happen if they break up. Lincoln is dismissive and harsh, while Fatima is sympathetic and asks why everyone can’t just be happy. Lincoln ends by telling her to be grateful, stop worrying so much about others, and compliments her, and Fatima replies affectionately with kisses.

79ae2153836c80eff9c4079e63ff0b7ae0a11c34.text: Brenda called Sandra to reconnect after about 25 years. Sandra had changed her name to Sandra Taylor and still lived in Kings Norton, while Brenda had moved to Stoke. They caught up on family news: Sandra has four grandchildren and the same husband, while Brenda’s husband Bill died five years ago and she has one grandchild. They reminisced about their days working together at the clothes factory, old social events like dinner dances, and dancing to Northern Soul and disco. Brenda mentioned that another former colleague, Marigold Carter, had died. Sandra suggested organizing a reunion for the Lister’s girls, and Brenda proposed meeting up just the two of them first. They agreed to meet next Saturday around 11 for lunch and a nostalgic catch-up.

f25abafe473c73a7b9a3577901d35c8208474031.text: George tried to set up a private meeting with Donna to discuss a delicate matter. Donna joked about whether he had AIDS, and George didn’t appreciate the joke. He suggested meeting at a coffee shop, but Donna pointed out that it wasn’t a good place for a sensitive conversation. George then asked her to come to his place that night instead.

19a70489a8fcd3fa5db6f7ae3f9d58462e229b7a.text: Tony shared a photo, and Amy and Lucas both reacted positively, calling the cat sweet, adorable, and cute.

3e1ab4f3e852b4314c3c3e0651faa6751abb6616.text: Crystal shared photos of her son, and Irene commented on how big and cute he is. Crystal said he’s grown out of his clothes, joking that buying new ones will bankrupt her. Irene offered to take him shopping and buy him something, saying she’s his aunt. Crystal hesitated, calling shopping a drag, and Irene teased her for being boring to shop with before saying to have fun. Crystal agreed.

97b409cbab3cf921854f857000c9f22a116d6d9c.text: Chris joked about pushing some girls into a pool and then saying they made them undress because they were soaking wet. June objected, saying it was mean and calling Chris awful.

52e9c72fd9f7f3bfe5301f5ebbfc63d467fc863a.text: Matt says he got a ticket for the Dawid Podsiadło concert and is excited. Thomas congratulates him, says he’ll probably go too, and asks Matt to remind him the day before. Matt agrees and asks who Thomas is going with; Thomas says he’s currently going by himself, then clarifies he meant “until now” jokingly. Matt says he’s excited too and may ask more people to come. Thomas mentions Maria might be interested and says he’ll ask her.

900676f495598c301bf9efe5d724ff1a8042622f.text: Luke says his train arrives at 3 pm and asks if anyone can pick him up. Jacob says he is at work until 5, and Fred offers to pick Luke up around 3:15, asking if that works. Luke agrees to wait and thanks Fred.

8aa55d4aac51b757ecb2e256b0548922719ad3d7.text: Ryan asks Jack if he’s going to the casting, joking with “So you think you can dance.” Jack says he is going this time and asks Ryan to come along. Ryan says he had thought about it, and Jack responds enthusiastically that he’ll meet Ryan there.

841a754c7a9f53de5d51cc3306db5340abc988cc.text: Paul asked Matthew whether he had found someone to coach the game on Saturday. Matthew said he was still looking, and Paul offered to do it since his plans changed. Matthew accepted and thanked him, and Paul confirmed he’d see him Saturday.

fe03f238a9f523a9ad3cf26d2e8d47d679666c6b.text: The group discussed going to a village party. Lia said she was too tired after hiking and wasn’t interested. Mico was enthusiastic, joking about wanting to meet “hot boys” and preferring “dumber” village boys, while Jim joked along in a crude way. Lia said it wasn’t her thing. In the end, Mico decided to go and asked if anyone wanted to join; Jeff agreed to go and offered to drive so Mico could drink, though he wasn’t very excited about it.

5af6ab909af7888ecb520ec35a03f04880e4fb52.text: Joanne and Evelyn talk about their holiday plans. Evelyn says she’ll stay home and rest because she’s been exhausted and busy lately. Joanne says she’s going back to France for Christmas, though she doesn’t really want to, because her parents recently separated and things are still tense. She explains that her father left her mother for his secretary, leaving her mother devastated, and Joanne plans to go home to support and cheer her up. Evelyn sympathizes and offers to have Joanne’s mother join them for Christmas, but Joanne says her mother is too depressed to travel.

6f82eb22feb54a64a66c902f2185cb1c0a63c10e.text: Carla checks in on Raul, asking how he is and what’s wrong. Raul says he’s not doing well and had a terrible night, evening, and morning. He says he started the day by smoking and doesn’t know what triggered him, but explains that Jen stayed overnight with a friend, leaving him alone, which he thought would be good, but instead he felt angry and upset. He also had unsettling dreams about his uncle. Carla responds with sympathy and support.

0f28ea0f5217164d8c4d683177f9a4b30a128af1.text: Kelvin asks Naheeda when they will take their CAT 2. Naheeda suggests doing it during statistics class, but Kelvin points out they will have a statistics CAT then, so that won’t work. She tells them to choose another time. Kelvin says he will consult the other class members and then inform her of their decision, and Naheeda asks him not to take too long.

aa5a1520438e31be010e1c49aefbe204d5fdbb0e.text: The group discussed lunch plans. They first considered sushi, but Karen said she was okay with sushi and just wanted something cheaper. Ronnie was craving sushi but agreed to save money. Linda suggested a nearby pasta place with takeout boxes, so they could eat in the park, and both Ronnie and Karen liked that idea. They then waited for Amanda, who eventually replied that pasta was fine with her too.

1cd55610fc07578a89e86e48bb19799f9bbde4ba.text: Willyx asked Alicja how her job interview went, and Alicja clarified that it was actually scheduled for tomorrow. Willyx apologized, and Alicja said it was okay. Willyx then asked her to let him know how it goes, and she agreed.

aa5e3dc603695168565fd15a1736400fc32b68e9.text: Marty asks Christine to pick up Marcel from school because he thinks he has sprained his ankle. Christine offers to take him to a doctor right away, but Marty says it can wait and worries about causing trouble with the kids. Christine agrees to pick up Marcel, offers to help further by taking Marcel to school the next morning and driving Marty to the doctor afterward, and reminds Marty to call the school. Marty thanks her repeatedly and says he will make the call.

2dee2342327488b92bcbf11c206f9cbfa114f9b6.text: Angie called to make a medical appointment but was initially reluctant to share her issue. Ms. Quinn explained that the information was needed to direct her to the right doctor and reassured her that the conversation wasn’t recorded. Angie then said she had severe stomach pain that started about an hour earlier and hadn’t improved after taking pills. She asked for her doctor, Cartman, but he wasn’t available, so Ms. Quinn scheduled her with Dr. McCormick in an hour and confirmed the appointment.

b6915cba855ee378cf3eb9a9edc0d1f2997706ef.text: Peyton keeps asking Cameron to bring a video game home, but Cameron says they’re out of town and won’t be back for another week. Peyton jokes about sending the game by courier and urges Cameron to finish up and come home as soon as possible.

2230ceb5457ae9b8109def642b97dee7220c13de.text: Paul said he had just come home after a busy day and realized he had forgotten his physiotherapy appointment. He reassured Emma that he would reschedule it. Emma said she would be home after midnight, and Paul kindly offered to prepare food for her, which she appreciated.

99d0675dd1180ebf331b73b1f73f07fc407db551.text: Sean said he overslept, Sam asked “Again??” in response, and Sean admitted it.

374fb7353b357526b6bfe2a95a584f55076ca8e4.text: Sophie asks Murphy when he is going to Poznań and whether he is returning the same day. Murphy says he is going on Tuesday and coming back that afternoon, though he doesn’t know the exact time.

3247637b5ae250c849960d56f6148779f00dcfbe.text: Adam asked Mike whether he had taken the dog for a walk. Mike said no because he didn’t have time, and Adam then said he would take the dog with him.

9baaab216c4281a66dcdb68e2bea67a628e31368.text: Harry asks Cindy to call Ela and tell her he needs to talk urgently and to answer his call. Cindy questions whether it’s another fight and complains about being used as a messenger, but Harry keeps pleading. She agrees to do it, grumbling that it’s the last time. Harry thanks her, and Cindy later tells him it’s done and he can call Ela now.

b569a88452f19bd540f08f7acfbdccf00252730d.text: Chris and Tom are making plans to hang out. Chris shares a photo, says he’ll be the middle person, and mentions Tom should bring swimming trunks because there’s a garden jacuzzi. Tom is excited and asks if the jacuzzi is big enough for several people and whether Chris and his brother will join him. Chris says it fits 5–6 people and they can invite others or just keep it a small group. They also talk about possibly watching TV outside, with Chris saying they can bring one out from the living room. Tom asks about Wi‑Fi and mentions he has limited mobile data when traveling outside Ireland. They end by expressing excitement about meeting up.

46a8df876dfba4313c7b075bb369a4c5dae4654e.text: Monica asks Gaia how she is doing and whether things are going well at university. Gaia says she’s fine, that school is busy but okay, and mentions she has six exams this term, though only one is especially difficult.

218209cfea87cd6e6627e549f760162d0c290293.text: Mr. Williams invited Ms. Blair to get coffee, and she happily accepted. They discussed a coffee shop she likes near the square, and agreed to meet there at 2 p.m.

9b0b6e3326fe09dbee23d7540ddbe7f8c1c43aea.text: Serena asked Jeff about his skin condition and whether he had recently seen a doctor. Jeff said it’s currently fine, though cold weather and certain foods can trigger it, and he only needs medication sometimes, not daily. Serena mentioned that Tina has the same condition and takes medication every day, and Jeff said Tina may have a different or more severe version. Serena said she’d tell Tina, and Jeff encouraged her to hang in there and offer to answer any questions.

140e75b28ed3b0fcc0851b032d01a193d6f30904.text: Mike said he couldn’t talk right then and would call back in 2 hours. Dale replied that it was fine and said “until then.”
